secondaryChannelAudit.reason: The website, structured identity, content packages, and larger public archive currently point to Captain Colin. Splitting new uploads across two channels weakens subscriber, recommendation, and returning-viewer signals.

recommended.description:
FPV flights, unusual gadgets, useful technology, and internet finds—tested when I can and researched honestly when I cannot.

I am Colin Michaels: an FPV pilot, applications developer, builder, and lifelong big kid. On Captain Colin, I fly Florida, dig into strange gear, and ask the question that matters after the thumbnail: is it actually useful?

Expect:
• Captain Colin Flies—FPV, drone tours, and the story behind the shot
• Is It Actually Useful?—gadgets, robots, marketplace finds, and practical verdicts
• One Annoying Problem, One Useful Fix—compact technology solutions

Some stories are hands-on. Some are first-person footage. Some are research. I will tell you which and link the sources, field notes, and updates at:
https://colinmichaels.com

Pick a playlist, then tell me what I should fly, test, or investigate next.

trailer.title: Welcome to Captain Colin: Gadgets, FPV & Internet Finds
trailer.script:
Hey, I am Colin. I fly FPV drones, chase weird technology, and I am still enough of a big kid to ask the question most adults stop asking: what happens if we try this?

Here you will find Florida flights, unusual gadgets, internet finds, and practical technology that solves an actual problem.

Some stories are hands-on. Some are field footage. Some are research. I will always tell you which—and I will tell you what the evidence does not prove.

The point is not to pretend everything is amazing. It is to find what is fun, what is useful, and what deserves a second look.

Pick the playlist that sounds like you, then tell me what I should fly, test, or investigate next. I am Captain Colin. Let us go find something worth talking about.
